app.name: AgentOffice
app.tagline: Your AI team, one desk each.
header.teamLocked: Finish or cancel the current task to switch teams.
office.title: Office
office.emptyBody: Pick a team template and the desks will fill up.
office.noTeamsBody: Add a team file to the teams/ folder and reload.
office.idleHint: Write a task below to put the team to work.
office.noWebgl: The 3D office needs WebGL, which isn't available here. Showing the simple board instead.
office.sceneError: The 3D office couldn't start, so the simple board is shown instead.
office.canvasLabel: 3D view of the office. The same information is in the panel on the right. Drag to turn the view, scroll or pinch to zoom.
quality.title: Graphics quality
quality.autoHint: Starts high and lowers itself if the scene runs slowly.
quality.lowHint: No shadows, lower resolution. Best for older devices.
panel.queueEmptyBody: When an agent delivers a report, it lands here for your approval.
panel.reportEmpty: Select a report from the queue or click a desk to read it.
queue.completedBody: The final output is approved. Open it from the coordinator's desk to export it.
report.olderVersion: You are viewing an older version.
report.noRevisionsLeft: Revision limit reached — approve to continue
task.label: Task
task.placeholder: Describe what the team should produce…
task.finishedHint: Status: {{status}}. Start a new task whenever you like.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Is it running?
errors.task_lost: This task is gone because the server restarted. Start a new one.
errors.revision_limit: The revision limit is reached; you can only approve now.
errors.invalid_state: That action isn't possible any more — the task has moved on.
